svg.title: Piyush Raj — The Systems Duel
svg.desc: A 32-second looping arcade boss fight. Piyush enters the arena, blocks a glitch creature, dodges, lands a three-hit combo, charges Margin Storm, defeats the boss and returns to idle. Backend, real-time and systems engineering.
svg.metadata: Original vector animation. One 32-second SMIL timeline generated by duel.py. No JavaScript or external assets.
svg.text: DESIGN FOR FAILURE. MEASURE THE REST.

g.text: FAILURE IS A STATE. RECOVERY IS A DESIGN.
